title.zh: US OCC calls on community banks to become payment stablecoin issuers
title.en: US OCC calls on community banks to become payment stablecoin issuers

current_state.zh: The US OCC, having finalized its rules implementing the GENIUS Act, publicly encouraged community banks to apply to become permitted payment stablecoin issuers ahead of the law's January enforcement date.
current_state.en: The US OCC, having finalized its rules implementing the GENIUS Act, publicly encouraged community banks to apply to become permitted payment stablecoin issuers ahead of the law's January enforcement date.
